summary: A Quote subscription survives the broker dropping the socket: the feed logs in again, asks for order updates again, subscribes the touchline again, and the snapshot Noren answers with is served.

notes: The desktop drops its cached snapshots on a new connection (appendix item 11); the web's Zebu adapter keeps them. A full snapshot follows every subscribe, so both serve the same frame here.

deviations.reason: The web's Zebu adapter forwards Noren's ltt as text (HH:MM:SS), or null when the frame has none; feed times are epoch milliseconds (docs), and a text copy of a time is not sent (docs/port/market-data-frames.md). The Noren family sends no ltt key (feed/dialect/names.rs).
Noren's touchline carries the book totals (tbq, tsq), and the web's Zebu Quote dict drops them: lost data. The desktop keeps them (lead decision: data a web adapter drops from a mode is kept).
